units: <cite ref="Chullin 48b:8-10">Ḥull. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>ההוא … בס׳ רבה דראה</he> a pin which was found in the large bronchus of the lungs.

<cite ref="Chullin 49a:3">Ib. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ רבא דכבדא</he> the large blood-vessel of the liver; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="O00720"><he>סִימְפּוֹנַיָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00718"><he>סִמְ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 47b:15">Ib. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>והוא דקיימי סִמְפּוֹנָהָא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>סמפונות</he>) provided its bronchiae are unaffected.
